tonight.headline: McLaurin has still not practised, so your flex is 2.3 short on paper; nothing of yours plays tonight
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4 and nothing got better overnight: McLaurin, Addison, Kamara and Monangai all missed Wednesday's practice, Likely was limited with a knee and groin nobody has explained, and no team practises again until this afternoon. You put Gordon in the flex last night, the one healthy back of the three. The projection still prefers McLaurin there by 2.3, and that waits for a practice.

The one new item is good. Jefferson told ESPN he intends to play on Sunday. As set you project 122.1 against 117.5 and ESPN gives you 52%. Tonight's game has none of your players and one of theirs: Bucky Irving, 15.3, at Dallas behind a rookie quarterback. Nothing needs doing today.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Ja'Marr Chase, their top projection at 21.9, is still in the concussion protocol and 'remains unlikely to play' (Paul Dehner Jr. via FantasyPros, 7 Oct). Bucky Irving plays tonight and is not on Tampa Bay's injury report; he had 16 touches and no targets in Week 4, and Jalon Daniels starts for Baker Mayfield. Chuba Hubbard is still in their flex on a bye at 0.0, so their 117.5 rises when they fix it. McBride 18.8, Purdy 18.0, London 16.0.

case.label: Your side
case.body: As set: Allen 20.1, Jefferson 18.6, Wilson 14.8, Warren 14.6, Tuten 14.0, Likely 12.9, Gordon 10.9, Fairbairn 8.5, the Vikings 7.8. Jefferson and Likely are questionable; both practised in part on Wednesday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson or Likely missing practice today and tomorrow, on your side. Chase being cleared, on theirs. McLaurin practising turns the flex back into a 2.3-point swap.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · read today's and Friday's reports · inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: Flex: McLaurin if he practises by Friday; otherwise leave Gordon
doFirst.subtitle: 13.2 against 10.9. You put Gordon in last night and that is right for now: McLaurin has not practised since the hamstring, and ESPN's number does not show it.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: As set you project 122.2; the projection lineup is 124.5. The whole 2.3 is McLaurin over Gordon in the flex, which the tool labels PROJECTION. It is outside the coin-flip line now that Gordon, not Kamara, holds the slot, so it goes in the decision log.

case.label: Why it is not set today
case.body: McLaurin did not practise on Wednesday and worked off to the side (commanders.com, 7 Oct 15:59; Washington Post via RotoWire). NBC Washington that evening: 'unclear if receiver Terry McLaurin will return'. That is newer than ESPN's 13.2 and runs against it. Stefon Diggs sat too. No Thursday practice has been held and I found no beat writer predicting Sunday either way.

case.label: The order
case.body: McLaurin if he practises today or tomorrow and is active. If not, the slot is between Gordon, 10.9, and Kamara, 11.2: a coin flip, so it goes to Kamara only if he has practised himself, and stays with Gordon if he has not. Gordon was not on Miami's report; Kamara missed Wednesday with his back. All three play at 11:00 on Sunday, so nothing locks early.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin starts in your flex and Gordon outscores him on Sunday (archive). If McLaurin does not practise or is inactive the swap never happens and the entry closes untested.

If Jefferson is inactive and Addison has not practised either, McLaurin moves to the receiver slot if he is healthy, and otherwise the flex and the slot go to Kamara and Gordon.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · decide on Friday's report · Juwan Johnson kicks off Sun 11:00 Mexico City, with Likely
doFirst.title: If Likely is ruled out: add Juwan Johnson, free
doFirst.subtitle: Likely was limited on Wednesday with a knee and groin listing nobody has explained, and you have nobody behind him. Johnson cleared waivers overnight. Do nothing today.

case.label: The hole
case.body: The lineup check prints it plainly: nobody eligible on the bench. The listing appeared on Wednesday afternoon (giants.com, 16:00) and a second day of searching found no account of how it happened. A limited practice usually ends in a start, and ESPN still projects 12.9.

case.label: Who is there
case.body: Juwan Johnson, 10.1, cleared waivers at 01:00 and is a free agent: targets 4, 8, 8 in the last three weeks (archive), not on the Saints' report, and he kicks off at 11:00 on Sunday, the same hour as Likely, so he can be added after the 09:30 inactive list. Dallas Goedert projects more, 10.9, but was limited himself on Wednesday (knee) and locks at 07:30 in London. Brenton Strange, 9.7, locks at 07:30 too. Mark Andrews, 9.6, has Lamar Jackson out of practice.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Addison, if Jefferson has practised again and Addison has not: he is hurt, on bye in Week 6 and 7.2 under Jefferson. If Jefferson's own status is in doubt on Friday, Addison is needed and the seat is Coker's instead, which means disagreeing with an 85%-rostered market for one week. Kamara and Gordon each have an injured teammate and cannot be named.

case.label: Why not add him today
case.body: He is free, so a rival can take him at any moment; Metcalf went that way on Wednesday. Against that, the strategy says not to carry a second tight end in a league whose flex cannot use one, and one limited practice is not a ruling. I am holding, and this is the call in this brief I am least sure of. If Likely misses practice today, add Johnson tonight and do not wait for Friday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Likely is ruled out and Johnson, Goedert, Strange and Andrews are all gone by then (the wait cost the slot). Or, if it fires, the tight end added scores less than the player dropped for him would have (archive). If Likely plays, this card never fires.
